mapper.select: SELECT t.*, count(1) AS count FROM asset_tag t WHERE t.tag LIKE CONCAT('%', #{key}, '%') GROUP BY t.tag ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT t.*, count(1) AS count FROM asset_tag t WHERE t.tag = #{key} AND t.value LIKE CONCAT('%', #{value}, '%') GROUP BY t.value ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT tag AS 'key', value, count(DISTINCT asset_id) AS total FROM asset_tag GROUP BY tag,value
